entities.name: Fragmentation & Galicia-Volhynia
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The fragmentation of Kievan Rus' into rival principalities. The Principality of Galicia-Volhynia under Roman the Great and Daniel of Halych (Galicia) emerged as the most powerful successor state in Ukrainian territory, maintaining European diplomatic ties.
